item.title: Letter: Keep Snohomish’s First Street authentic, honor past
item.description: I grew up in the 1940s and 1950s living at Avenue E and First Street in the city of Snohomish. First Street always was a place to go back in time, a diamond in the rough, reflecting the character of early American Indians and settlers engaged in farming and logging.
